title: Finance Coordinator
description:
Finance Coordinator, Europe



Full-time, Remote (Employee or Consultant)

Shift: Monday to Friday, aligned to Central European (CET) business hours

Reports to: Finance Manager

Rate: $400 USD per week



ROLE OVERVIEW



The Finance Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day finance operations across the Swedish and Norwegian entities of a European fashion business, while also supporting Australian payment flows.



This role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, processing accounts payable and receivable, reconciling multiple bank accounts, managing multi-currency transactions, and supporting weekly and monthly financial reporting.



Working across multiple entities and currencies, the Finance Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the finance function. This position also manages shared finance inboxes and works closely with the Finance Manager to ensure financial processes are completed accurately and on time.



SCOPE

- Support finance operations across Swedish, Norwegian and Australian entities

- Manage multiple bank accounts across Sweden and Norway

- Work with SEK, EUR, NOK and USD currencies

- Process transactions across Bankgiro, Shopify, PayPal, marketplace and manual payment channels



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Accounts Payable

- Register, code and process supplier invoices within Garp ERP

- Manage company credit card transactions and employee expense claims

- Process recurring payments, supplier payments and international payments

- Maintain accurate supporting documentation and financial records



Accounts Receivable

- Process customer receipts across all payment channels

- Reconcile incoming payments and customer accounts

- Respond to customer and sales agent finance enquiries

- Manage prepayments and support debt collection activities



Banking & Currency

- Update daily exchange rates within Garp

- Process bank transfers

- Maintain banking trackers and reconciliation records

- Reconcile multiple bank and foreign currency accounts



Reporting & Compliance

- Prepare agent statements and reporting in Microsoft Excel

- Process journals for suppliers, invoices and agents

- Support monthly reporting requirements

- Prepare VAT and EC Sales List reporting

- Assist with month-end accruals and depreciation journals

- Shared Finance Support

- Manage shared finance inboxes

- Respond to supplier, customer and agent enquiries

- Escalate finance issues where required

- Support the Finance Manager with day-to-day finance administration



SYSTEMS & TOOLS

The ideal candidate will have experience working with:

- Garp ERP

- Microsoft Excel (including VLOOKUP and reconciliation)

- Shopify

- PayPal

- Banking portals

- Marketplace payment platforms

- UPS Portal

- VAT and EC Sales reporting systems



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

- Previous experience in a Bookkeeping, Finance Coordinator or Accounts role

- Strong Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable experience

- Experience working with manual ledger entries and account coding

- Multi-currency accounting experience

- Strong bank and balance sheet reconciliation skills

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including VLOOKUP

- High attention to detail and strong numerical accuracy

- Excellent organisational and time management skills

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines



Highly Regarded

- Experience using Garp ERP

- Experience with Swedish VAT reporting

- Experience preparing EC Sales List submissions

- Previous experience within retail, fashion or ecommerce businessesTO APPLY



To Apply

1.Submit your most updated CV

A brief introduction outlining your relevant finance and bookkeeping experience



2. Answers to the application screening questions below

- Please describe your experience in bookkeeping or finance coordination. Include the industries you've worked in, the size of the businesses you supported, and the types of finance responsibilities you handled.



- Which accounting systems, ERP platforms, and finance tools have you used? Please indicate your level of proficiency with each (e.g. Garp, Xero, SAP, Microsoft Excel, Shopify, PayPal, etc.).



- Tell us about your experience managing Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank reconciliations, and multi-currency transactions. Which currencies have you worked with?



- Why do you believe you're the right fit for this role, and when would you be available to start if selected?

title: Direct Response Copywriter & Quality Lead (Remote)
description:
We’re building the future of men’s wellness in the Philippines—starting with skincare—and we’re looking for a senior direct response copywriter who can do more than write great hooks.



We’re looking for someone who can explain why copy converts, not just that it does.



The Role



As our Direct Response Copywriter & Quality Lead, you’ll be both:



A high-output writer (ads, landing pages, hook stacks, influencer briefs)

A quality gatekeeper for everything the team ships



You’ll write in Taglish and Tagalog for Filipino men aged 35–55, crafting performance-driven copy that turns cold traffic into buyers.



Every piece of copy is treated as a hypothesis. Your job is to identify what works, what doesn’t, and defend those decisions using data—not opinion.



What You’ll Do



Write ad scripts, hooks, landing pages, and influencer briefs daily

Develop new angles based on performance data and competitor insights

Review and rewrite team copy before anything goes live

Build and maintain swipe files of winning ads and hooks

Translate metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate) into creative decisions

Ensure every piece of copy has clear reasoning behind it



What We’re Looking For



5+ years in direct response copywriting (eCommerce/performance marketing)

Proven experience writing for Filipino audiences (Taglish/Tagalog required)

Strong understanding of hooks, persuasion, and buyer psychology

Comfortable using AI tools daily to iterate and improve copy

Experience reviewing, rewriting, and improving other writers’ work

Data-driven thinking (not “it feels right,” but “here’s why it works”)

Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced remote environment



How We Work



We don’t guess. We test.

Every hook, angle, and landing page exists for a reason—and that reason must be explainable.

If you can’t defend why a hook works, it’s not ready.

If you can’t trace a winner back to the decisions behind it, it can’t be repeated.

We hire for thinking first. Writing follows.



Details



Remote (Philippines-based team)

Salary: PHP 70,000–100,000/month (based on experience & output)

Benefits: Government-mandated (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month, leave)

Performance-based incentives available

6-month probationary period

title: Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a full-time Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant to support the front end of the residential loan pipeline.



This role is focused on four key areas: borrower intake, document collection and verification, Floify file management, and pipeline tracking.



The ideal candidate has prior mortgage operations experience, strong attention to detail, clear communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



This is not a general admin role. We are looking for someone who understands mortgage documentation, borrower communication, and the importance of keeping loan files organized, accurate, and updated.



Work Schedule

Full-time position

Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time

160 hours per month



Candidates must be able to work during Eastern business hours in real time.



Rate

$8 to $10 per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



Candidates with stronger mortgage operations experience, strong tool familiarity, and proven ability to work independently will be considered at the higher end of the range.



Main Responsibilities

1. Borrower Intake

The VA will help manage the first stage of the borrower process and make sure new leads are handled properly and on time.



Tasks include:

Acknowledge new leads promptly

Make initial borrower contact during business hours

Collect and confirm borrower information

Gather 1003 application details

Open and organize the borrower file

Set up borrower information in Floify

Explain the document process, next steps, and basic timeline to borrowers

Make sure borrower communication is clear, professional, and timely



2. Document Collection and Verification

The VA will be responsible for helping collect borrower documents and checking that files are complete, clear, and properly organized.



Tasks include:



Send initial document request lists to borrowers

Follow up on missing documents

Review uploaded documents for completeness

Check for missing pages, expired documents, unclear scans, or inconsistent information

Flag issues or discrepancies for the team

Make sure required borrower documents are collected and organized

Apply the correct file naming format

Keep documentation clean, accurate, and easy to review



3. Floify File Management

The VA will maintain borrower files inside Floify and make sure each workspace is updated and borrower-ready.



Tasks include:



Create and maintain borrower workspaces in Floify

Build and update document needs lists

Send and update document requests

Monitor document uploads

Update milestones and file status

Keep the borrower portal organized

Make sure all borrower-facing communication inside the system is professional and current

Maintain clean and accurate file records



4. Pipeline Tracking

The VA will help keep the loan pipeline updated so the team can clearly see the status of each active file.



Tasks include:



Update the pipeline board daily

Track each file by stage, next action, and aging

Identify stalled files or delayed borrower responses

Follow up before files become delayed

Provide a clear daily status view of active intake and documentation files

Make sure the team knows what needs attention each day



Required Experience and Skills

The ideal candidate should have:



At least 2 years of experience in mortgage operations, loan processing support, or loan officer support

Experience with U.S. residential lending is strongly preferred

Familiarity with the 1003 application

Understanding of common mortgage documents, including income, asset, credit, and identity documents

Experience reviewing documents for completeness and accuracy

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow SOPs and naming conventions

Ability to manage multiple files and deadlines

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Professional borrower communication skills

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment



Tools and Systems

Experience with the following tools is preferred:



Floify

Calyx Point

GoHighLevel

Airtable

Notion

WhatsApp

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office



Floify and Calyx Point experience are strongly preferred. Candidates who do not have direct experience must be able to demonstrate strong mortgage operations knowledge and ability to learn quickly.



Performance Expectations

The VA should be able to support the team by maintaining strong standards in the following areas:



New leads acknowledged within the required response window

Borrower messages handled professionally and on time

Submitted documents reviewed within 24 hours

Files named and organized correctly

Pipeline updated daily

Floify workspace kept clean, current, and borrower-ready

Issues flagged early before they create delays



Assessment Requirement

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a 3-part assessment before final selection.



The assessment will be sent once candidates are shortlisted and must be completed within the given timeframe.



The assessment includes:



Part A: Knowledge Assessment

Written mortgage fundamentals

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Part B: Tool Proficiency Assessment

Hands-on / practical tasks

Estimated completion time: 40 minutes



Part C: Scenario & Communication Assessment

Applied borrower situations

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Candidates must complete and pass all three parts to move forward in the hiring process.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:



Detail-oriented

Organized

Reliable

Comfortable with deadlines

Proactive in follow-ups

Clear and professional in communication

Experienced in mortgage operations

Able to manage borrower-facing tasks with care

Confident working independently

Careful with compliance boundaries



This role is best suited for a senior VA who has handled mortgage operations or loan processing support before and can help keep borrower intake, document collection, Floify files, and pipeline tracking running smoothly.





How to Apply:

Provide an updated CV together with your cover letter breaking down your relevant experience and skills that fit the role.

title: Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator to support daily operations, improve systems, and build automation-driven workflows across a nonprofit organization and a real estate acquisition business.



This is a senior-level role for someone who can take rough, incomplete, or ambiguous instructions and turn them into clear plans, finished work, documented processes, and improved systems.



This is not a standard Executive Assistant or general Virtual Assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can think, structure, execute, verify, improve, and automate.



The right candidate must be comfortable working independently, using AI as part of their daily workflow, and building automations that reduce manual work over time.



Position Details



Role Title: Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator

Experience Level: Senior

Position Type: Full-time

Hours: 30 hours per week initially

Work Setup: Remote

Schedule: Async-first

Target Rate: $7 to $8 per hour, depending on experience

Start Date: Within 7 days



Work Schedule



This is an async-first role.



You can generally work when it works best for you, as long as work is completed on time, properly verified, and clearly communicated.



This is not a graveyard-shift role and does not require full US business hours.



There may be occasional brief overlap with US Eastern Time for quick coordination, phone calls, quote requests, two-factor authentication logins, or time-sensitive items.



Preferred overlap windows:



8:00 AM to 11:00 AM ET

4:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET



Output, ownership, reliability, and self-management matter more than fixed hours.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who can turn ambiguity into clarity.



You should be able to receive a rough idea, incomplete instruction, or messy operational problem and turn it into something structured, finished, verified, documented, and easier to repeat next time.



You should not need every step spelled out before you can move.



You should be able to:



Understand the goal behind the task

Create the plan

Execute the work

Verify the result

Document the process

Improve the workflow

Identify what can be automated



The goal of this role is to reduce operational load, keep work moving, and build systems that become cleaner, faster, and more automated over time.



Core Working Loop



The role follows this loop:



Create ? Execute ? Verify ? Improve ? Automate



This means you do not just complete tasks.



You are expected to make the work better each time it comes back.



If something is repeated, document it.

If something is manual, look for ways to improve it.

If something can be automated, suggest or build the automation.

If something is unclear, create structure and move it forward.



Main Responsibilities

1. Turn Ambiguous Instructions Into Clear Plans



You will often receive rough, incomplete, or high-level instructions.



Your responsibility is to turn them into clear, organized, and actionable work.



Tasks include:



Interpret unclear or incomplete instructions

Identify the real goal of the task

Make reasonable assumptions when needed

Break down messy requests into clear next steps

Create structure without waiting for every detail

Propose a path forward when something is unclear

Execute the work independently

Communicate blockers early and clearly

Provide decision-ready options when needed



You should be comfortable creating clarity instead of waiting for it.



2. Own Work From Start to Finish



You will be expected to own the full task loop, not just complete isolated steps.



Tasks include:



Take ownership of assigned work

Complete the work fully

Check and verify your own output

Open files, click links, test workflows, and confirm results before marking anything done

Follow through without needing reminders

Document what was done

Make the task easier to repeat next time

Close open loops before they become problems



When you say something is done, it should already be checked and confirmed.



3. Manage Daily Operations



You will help manage day-to-day operational work across nonprofit and real estate-related functions.



Tasks may include:



Manage tasks and workflows in Asana

Support workflows in Wrike or similar project management tools

Organize and update project boards

Track deadlines, follow-ups, and next actions

Handle invoices, receipts, and expense platforms

Support operational finance tasks

Manage documents and files

Coordinate signatures

Support calendars and inboxes

Track account portals and administrative items

Keep systems organized and current

Make sure nothing drops, stalls, or gets missed



The goal is to keep operations moving without constant check-ins.



4. Create and Improve SOPs



You will be responsible for documenting repeatable work and improving existing processes.



Tasks include:



Create SOPs for recurring tasks

Improve unclear or outdated SOPs

Document workflows clearly

Make processes easy for another person to follow

Identify friction in existing workflows

Suggest better ways to complete repeated tasks

Build systems that do not depend on memory, reminders, or constant follow-up

Prepare processes for future automation



If a task is done more than once, it should eventually become a documented process.



5. Build AI and Automation Workflows



AI-first work is required for this role.



We are looking for someone who already uses AI tools as a default part of their workflow, not someone who is only curious about AI.



You should already be using AI for:



Research

Drafting

Summarizing

Analysis

SOP creation

Problem-solving

Workflow improvement

Documentation

Data or list cleaning

Repetitive task reduction



You should also have experience building automations using tools such as:



Zapier

Make

AI workflows

Light scripting

Google Sheets automation

Apps Script

n8n or similar tools



Tasks include:



Identify repetitive manual work

Build simple and effective automations

Turn SOPs into automated workflows

Use AI to reduce time spent on repetitive tasks

Test automations before calling them complete

Document how automations work

Track what time or effort the automation saves

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Remote)

Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time  

Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm AEST (7:00am-3:00pm PH Time) | ?70,000-?100,000/month

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Build The Marketing Engine Behind One Of Australia’s Fast-Growing Social Media Agencies



Social Status is on a mission to become Australia’s most respected social media agency.



We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take ownership of our entire demand generation function and help drive the next stage of our growth.



This isn’t an agency client management role.



This isn’t a campaign execution role.



This is an opportunity to build, optimise and own the marketing systems that generate leads for our business.



We’re looking for the top 1% of marketers.



If you’re simply looking for another marketing job, this probably isn’t it.



If you’re looking for genuine ownership, autonomy and the opportunity to build something exceptional alongside an ambitious leadership team, we’d love to hear from you.



You’ll have approximately AUD $10,000 per month in advertising budget across Meta, LinkedIn and Google to drive qualified leads while taking ownership of the entire marketing funnel beyond the click.



We’re prepared to pay exceptionally well for an exceptional marketer. If you’ve consistently generated outstanding results and can prove it, we’ll happily invest in you.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



About Social Status



At Social Status, we believe social media is the most powerful marketing channel on the planet when it’s executed properly.



We partner with ambitious businesses across Australia to help them grow through strategic social media marketing, paid advertising and content creation.



As we continue to scale, we’re investing heavily in our own marketing. That’s where you come in.



You’ll work directly with the leadership team to build a world-class marketing engine that consistently generates qualified opportunities, strengthens our brand and helps us stand out in a competitive market.



You’ll have genuine ownership over strategy, execution and continuous improvement. We’re not looking for someone to maintain what’s already there. We’re looking for someone to help build what’s next.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



The Role



You’ll own our entire marketing funnel, from generating awareness through to booked sales calls.



Rather than specialising in a single channel, you’ll be responsible for ensuring every part of our marketing ecosystem works together to attract, nurture and convert high-quality leads.



You’ll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, recommend improvements, test new ideas and continually optimise performance based on data.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What You’ll Be Doing



* Planning, building and optimising Meta, LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns against qualified lead and cost-per-lead targets

* Managing approximately AUD $10,000 per month in advertising spend across multiple channels

* Managing
 marketing, CRM segmentation and automation inside GoHighLevel

* Building and optimising landing pages with a strong focus on conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

* Writing high-converting ad copy, landing pages,
 campaigns and other marketing assets

* Building scalable marketing systems and automations that reduce manual processes

* Monitoring campaign performance and making proactive recommendations based on data

* Producing weekly reports covering lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates and channel performance

* Working closely with leadership to ensure every campaign aligns with our ideal client profile and commercial objectives

* Continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance across the entire marketing funnel

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What Success Looks Like



We don’t believe in waiting 12 months to know whether a role is working.



We don’t expect perfection in your first 90 days, but we do expect 
ntum.



Within your first 90 days, we’d expect you to:



* Develop a deep understanding of our business, customers and ideal client profile

* Take ownership of our paid advertising, CRM and marketing systems

* Identify and implement meaningful improvements across our marketing funnel

* Reduce cost per qualified lead through better campaign management and optimisation

* Improve landing page conversion rates through testing and refinement

* Deliver clear reporting that helps leadership make better commercial decisions



Longer term, success means becoming the strategic owner of our entire marketing function, continuously improving lead quality, conversion rates and the systems that support our growth.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What’s In It For You?



* ?70,000-?100,000 per month depending on experience and proven results

* Annual salary reviews based on performance

* Genuine ownership over a function being built from the ground up

* Direct access to leadership with minimal bureaucracy

* A fast-growing business where great ideas are implemented quickly

* Long-term career progression as the company continues to scale

* A collaborative team that values continuous improvement and high performance

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys solving marketing problems and improving commercial outcomes.



You’ll ideally have:



* Minimum 5 years experience managing multi-channel performance marketing campaigns with measurable commercial results

* Proven expertise across Meta Ads, Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads

* Strong experience building and optimising landing pages with a solid understanding of conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

* Excellent copywriting skills across paid ads, landing pages,
 marketing and sales funnels

* Advanced GoHighLevel knowledge, including CRM management, automations, workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, opportunities and reporting

* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation and conversion optimisation

* Experience building sophisticated
 marketing campaigns, nurture sequences and audience segmentation

* Excellent written English with the ability to write naturally for an Australian audience

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and confidently make recommendations backed by numbers

* Experience marketing to B2B or professional service businesses

* A proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge ideas, identify opportunities and continuously improve performance



Most importantly, you’ll be someone who takes ownership. You don’t wait to be told what needs improving. You identify opportunities, present solutions and take action.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



This Role Probably Isn’t For You If…



* You prefer executing tasks rather than owning outcomes

* You’re only comfortable managing a single marketing channel

* You wait for direction instead of proactively identifying opportunities

* You’re more interested in launching campaigns than improving performance

* You enjoy maintaining the status quo more than building something better

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Why You’ll Love Working With Us



We’re building something ambitious.



Our goal is simple: become Australia’s most respected social media agency.



That means surrounding ourselves with exceptional people who care about doing great work, continually improving and helping build something they’re genuinely proud of.



We move quickly, make decisions based on data and believe the best ideas should win, regardless of where they come from. If you have a better idea, we want to hear it.



You’ll work directly with leadership, have real influence over strategy and be trusted to make meaningful decisions that shape the future of our marketing.



If you’re looking for a role where your ideas matter, your results are recognised and your career can grow alongside the business, we’d love to hear from you.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Interested?



Before You Apply



Please include the following with your application:



* Your resume.

* A short cover letter explaining why you’re interested in this role.

* Links to any campaigns, case studies or portfolios you’re proud of.

* Your expected monthly salary (PHP).

* Confirmation that you’re available to work Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm AEST (7:00am-3:00pm PH Time).

* Confirmation that this will be your only full-time role.



We’d also like you to answer these five questions:



1. Tell us about one marketing campaign you’re most proud of. What was the objective, what did you change and what measurable results did you achieve?

2. If you joined Social Status tomorrow, what would be the first three things you’d review before making any marketing changes, and why?

3. What’s one marketing opinion or strategy you strongly believe in that many marketers disagree with?

4. Which digital marketing platforms and tools have you used extensively? Please rate your confidence out of 10 for each (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GoHighLevel,
 Marketing, Landing Pages/CRO and Analytics).

5. In 200 words or less, tell us why you’re the right person to build the marketing engine behind Social Status.



Applications that don’t include the above information may not be considered.



If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for, we’ll be in touch to discuss the next steps.

About Us:

We are a premium Virtual CFO and Controllership firm based in the US. We do not sell cheap bookkeeping. We provide high-ticket, strategic financial management to 7-figure and 8-figure businesses (primarily in the Construction sector) with monthly retainers ranging from $2,800 to $10,000+.



The Role:

We are seeking a highly polished, strategic B2B Outbound Specialist to own our cold
 lead generation engine. This is a part-time role (approx. 20 hours/week) requiring overlap with US business hours.



We are not looking for a data-entry assistant to blindly press "send." We are looking for an outbound professional who understands the psychology of high-ticket B2B sales, knows how to navigate 
 with surgical precision, and can correspond with multimillion-dollar CEOs with absolute confidence and flawless English.



Key Responsibilities:



Strategic List Building: Utilize 
 to build highly accurate, targeted lists of US business owners, filtering for specific revenue markers ($1M - $25M), headcounts, and tech stacks.



Campaign Execution & Optimization: Manage our sending infrastructure (Instantly.ai / Lemlist). You will be responsible for loading campaigns, A/B testing subject lines, and ensuring technical deliverability stays pristine.



Executive Inbox Triage: Monitor campaign inboxes daily. You will be the first point of contact for interested prospects. You must reply with high-level professional polish, secure the appointment on our Calendly, and gracefully handle basic initial objections.



Performance Reporting: Provide weekly wrap-ups on open rates, reply rates, and meetings booked, offering proactive suggestions to improve conversion.



Requirements:



Top-Tier Communication: Flawless, native-level written English. You must understand Western B2B business culture and communicate with brevity and authority.



Technical Expertise: Deep experience with 
 and modern sending platforms (Instantly, Lemlist). You must understand the basics of
 deliverability (bounce rates, domain warm-up, spam traps).



Track Record: Proven experience booking qualified meetings for high-ticket B2B services or SaaS.



Autonomy: You are a problem-solver who requires minimal hand-holding. You thrive on being handed a target and building the operational engine to hit it.



Compensation:

We pay top-of-market rates for top-tier talent. Compensation is highly competitive and commensurate with your high-level experience.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

We receive hundreds of applications and use the following steps to filter for extreme attention to detail. If you do not follow these steps exactly, your application will be instantly discarded.



Start your cover letter with the word "Bluebird".

title: Full-Time Short-Form Editor Who Can Build a Reel From Raw, Unscripted Footage
description:
READ THIS WHOLE POST. There is an instruction at the bottom that

will eliminate most applicants. That's intentional.



WHO WE ARE



Sotena Group is a US-based agency. We build content and operational

systems for service businesses. Right now that means roofing

companies, home health agencies, and our own brand. More clients are

coming.



THE ACTUAL JOB



Most editing jobs hand you a script and a shot list. This one does

not.



I film constantly. Phone footage, long unscripted takes, client

walkthroughs, job sites, me talking to a camera for eleven minutes

straight. Ninety percent of it is unusable. Somewhere in the other

ten percent is a hook, a story, and a reason for someone to stop

scrolling.



Your job is to find it.



You will receive raw folders with zero direction. You will watch

everything. You will pull the 
nts that carry weight. Then you

will turn those 
nts into finished short-form pieces:



  - Reels with music, pacing, cuts on beat

  - Talking-head cuts with word-level captions

  - Story posts with text overlays that read fast

  - B-roll sequences that make a boring trade look expensive

  - Client-facing content in a totally different voice than mine



You d
 the hook. You d
 the cut. You write the on-screen

text. You choose the sound. I approve or I redirect. I am not going

to hold your hand and I am not going to give you timestamps.



WHAT YOU ACTUALLY NEED



  - Fluent in Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro or DaVinci. I do not care

    which. I care that you are fast.

  - You understand retention. You know why the first 1.2 seconds

    d
 everything. You can explain what a pattern interrupt is

    without googling it.

  - You can write. Hooks, captions, on-screen text. In English that

    sounds like a human, not a translation.

  - Sound design is not an afterthought for you.

  - You have opinions about pacing and you can defend them.

  - You can take a 90-minute raw file and hand me three finished

    pieces without asking me a single question about what to use.



VOLUME AND RHYTHM



Expect 15 to 25 finished short-form pieces per week across two or

three brands. Some weeks are heavier. Some weeks you are digging

through backlog. There is always a backlog.



You will work inside our systems. Notion or Airtable for the

pipeline, Google Drive or 
 for delivery. You will log what

you cut and why. I want to be able to see your reasoning.



WHO THIS IS WRONG FOR



  - You need a script before you can start

  - You have a template you apply to every video

  - You edit exactly what you are told and nothing more

  - You have never posted your own content and watched it fail

  - You are juggling four clients and this is client five



WHO THIS IS RIGHT FOR



Someone who watches short-form obsessively, has strong taste, is

tired of editing to spec for people with no vision, and wants to be

the reason a brand grows instead of the person who exports the file.



PAY AND GROWTH



$1,200 USD per month to start. 40 hours per week. Paid on the 1st

and 15th, no exceptions, no late payments, ever.



At 90 days, if you are what this post describes, we go to $1,500.

At six months we discuss $1,800 and a per-brand bonus structure as

we add clients.



Philippine holidays observed. 13th month pay. Paid time off after

90 days.



This is a long-term seat. I am building a team, not filling a gap.

The person who takes this role and takes it seriously will end up

leading the editing side of this company.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send me a cover letter. Do not tell me you are a passionate

video editor. Do not tell me you hope this message finds me well.

Anything that opens with a template gets deleted before I finish

the first line.



Send exactly this, in this order:



1. Start your message with the word CLEAVER on its own line.

   No CLEAVER, no read.



2. Three links to short-form videos YOU personally cut. Not team

   projects. Not agency reels. Yours.



3. Pick ONE of those three. In under 150 words, tell me what you

   CUT OUT and why. I do not care what you left in. I care about

   what you killed and what your reasoning was.



4. One sentence: the last piece of short-form content that made you

   stop scrolling, and the specific technical reason it worked.



5. Your editing software, your turnaround time on one 30-second

   reel from raw, and your timezone overlap with Pacific Time.



Strong applicants get a paid test: one raw folder, 48 hours, three

finished pieces, $50 flat regardless of outcome. If the test is

excellent you start the following Monday.

title: Administrative Assistant – Academic Research & Project Coordination Part-time | Remote | Long-term | ~10 hours/week
description:
I’m an assistant professor and researcher at a graduate theological school in Berkeley, CA, currently directing an oral history project focused on Asian American and Pacific Islander communities. I’m looking for a detail-oriented administrative assistant to support my research, student advising, and calendar management on an ongoing basis.



What you’ll be doing



 • Tracking and maintaining records for a roster of graduate student advisees (deadlines, milestones, follow-ups)

 • Scheduling and coordinating interviews for an active oral history research project, including outreach to participants and logistics tracking

 • Managing my calendar — appointments, meetings, deadlines, and reminders

 • Preparing brief reports so we can review status together on regular Zoom check-ins

 • General administrative tasks:
 drafting, document organization, file management



What I’m looking for



 • Strong written English and communication skills

 • Experience with Google Calendar, Google Drive, and spreadsheets

 • Reliable internet connection and availability for Zoom check-ins

 • Organized, proactive, and comfortable working async with a supervisor who trusts you to flag problems early

 • Prior experience supporting academics or researchers is a plus but not required



Hours and compensation



 • Approximately 10 hours per week, with some flexibility as project phases shift

 • $8/hour, paid weekly via Wise



About the research



This position supports two interconnected bodies of work. The first is the PANA Oral Narratives Project, a commissioned oral history archive documenting the lives and activism of Asian American and Pacific Islander religious leaders and community organizers. The second is a book manuscript under contract with an academic press. Both projects involve interview coordination, archival organization, and ongoing correspondence with scholars, community members, and institutional partners.



About the field



I’m a scholar of Christian ethics, liturgical studies, and decolonial theory, working at the intersection of Asian American studies, feminist theology, and community-based research. My work is academic but community-rooted — you’ll be supporting correspondence and logistics that connect a university context with Filipino American and broader AAPI communities. Familiarity with academic or nonprofit environments is helpful; deep knowledge of the field is not necessary.



About our check-ins



We’ll meet on Zoom on a regular cadence — likely biweekly — for you to walk me through a status report on active tasks: interview scheduling, advisee milestones, calendar, and any open items. I’ll use these meetings to give direction and answer questions. Outside of those meetings, the work is fully async, so strong written communication and the ability to flag problems proactively are essential.



To apply



Please send a brief introduction — who you are, your relevant experience, and why this role interests you. A sample of a document you’ve organized or a process you’ve managed is welcome but optional.

title: The Sales Right Hand (Setter + Executive Assistant)
description:
Think... Sales Meets Founder's Secret Weapon



Let's be real for a second. Most sales support ads want someone to copy-paste scripts into DMs. Most EA ads want someone to book meetings and stay invisible. This is not that job. This is both jobs, done brilliantly, by one rare human.



At The Event Engineer, we help visionary entrepreneurs scale past the 7-figure mark by building world-class event systems. We don't do "average," and we don't do generic. We have an active pipeline, ongoing leads, and live events on the horizon, and right now, our founder, Lisa Barry, needs a true right hand across sales and her day-to-day.



We are looking for a rare human who is a 50/50 split between an Elite Sales Setter and a Meticulous Executive Assistant. If you get a little thrill from turning a cold DM into a booked call, chasing a warm lead until they say yes, and running a founder's calendar with zero clashes... welcome home.



Here's the best part: you will NOT be closing the clients. Lisa handles the final sales conversion. Your job is to fill her calendar with qualified, warm prospects and keep every deal moving. When she closes them, you win. Literally. There's a bonus with your name on it for every single deal.



What You'll Own (Your Playground):



THE SALES SIDE

Speed-to-Lead: Incoming chats, social DMs, and
 replies, answered fast. When a lead raises their hand, you're already typing. Fast responses win deals, and you take that personally.

Conversational Setting: Natural, human, text-based selling. You ask smart, open-ended questions, you understand buyer psychology, and you never sound like a script. You warm them up and book them onto Lisa's calendar, qualified and ready.

Follow-Up That Never Sleeps: The deal isn't done when the call ends. You own every lead after their sales call: keeping relationships warm, chasing invoices (charmingly), and moving every deal forward until it's closed or dead. No lead ever slips through the cracks on your watch.

Event Campaigns: Live events are our engine. You'll message event attendees, qualify the hot ones, and book them into the system.

GoHighLevel Pipeline Ownership: Everything lives in GHL, and your pipeline stays immaculate: stages, tasks, conversations, triggers and automations, all flawless. If a lead goes quiet, you notice before anyone else does.



THE EA SIDE

Lisa's Calendar: Book it, move it, protect it. You coordinate scheduling around sales calls, events and travel, and nothing ever double-books.

Her Inbox & Daily Details: You triage
, handle bookings, reminders and follow-up notes, and clear the small stuff before she has to think about it. You are the reason her day runs smoothly so she can stay focused on delivery and closing.

ClickUp: Your corner of our workspace stays current, so the team knows the state of the pipeline and the calendar at a glance.



Who You Are:

A Salesperson at Heart: You love the chase. A booked call feels like a win because it is one.

Lightning in Human Form: You physically cannot leave a message unanswered. Speed is your love language.

A Natural Conversationalist: Flawless written English. Warm, professional, and human. No rigid, robotic scripts. Ever.

An EA Instinct: You've protected a busy founder's or executive's time before. You anticipate, you don't wait.

An Autonomous Thinker: You see a quiet lead, a calendar clash, or an un-followed-up task and you immediately take action. Nobody has to tell you.

Advanced GoHighLevel proficiency: pipelines, workflows, conversations, and triggers. You know GHL inside and out. Non-negotiable.

lbourne time (Full-Time, matching Aussie hours!)

title: Automation Specialist — Build the Operational Backbone of a Talent Management Agency
description:
About the Project



I run a boutique talent management agency managing brand partnerships for UK reality TV and influencer talent. We handle the full lifecycle of brand deals — from first contact through to content delivery and payment.



Right now, too much of this process lives in people's heads and relies on manual follow-through. Deals stall because someone didn't chase a contract. Invoices go out late because no one flagged that content had been posted. Approvals sit in inboxes because there's no automated nudge.



I need someone to look at our deal operations workflow and build automations that make it run reliably — so the process drives itself and people are prompted to act rather than having to remember.



I'm not married to any specific platform. We currently use Protonmail, Google Drive, and WhatsApp. I'm completely open to new tools — if the right solution involves Make, n8n, Zapier, Airtable, Notion, a CRM, or something else entirely, I want your recommendation based on what actually works best.



The Workflow You're Automating



Every brand deal follows this journey. Your job is to make each transition automatic, tracked, and chased without anyone having to remember.



Stage 1 — Brand shows interest

A new contact is added to our Deals Tracker (currently Google Sheets). This should trigger the next step automatically.



Stage 2 — First response

A templated
 goes out to the brand with our rates, pitch deck, and talent suggestions. The founder is CC'd. Right now this is done manually and sometimes late.



Stage 3 — Deal confirmed

The founder confirms the deal. Once marked as confirmed in the tracker, the system should automatically generate a checklist of what's needed from the brand: campaign brief, contract, deliverables, deadlines — and request them.



Stage 4 — Admin and coordination

Documents come in from the brand. The system tracks what's been received and what's outstanding. If a brief or contract hasn't arrived within a set window, a chase goes out automatically. Everything is logged.



Stage 5 — Content coordination

Content drafts are sent to brands for approval. If approval doesn't come back within 48 hours, the system chases. Once approved, the posting date is confirmed. Once posted, the system triggers the invoicing step.



Stage 6 — Invoicing and payment

Invoice is sent when content goes live. Payment is tracked against terms. Reminders go out automatically at set intervals — 7 days before due, on the due date, 3 days overdue, 7 days overdue. I only hear about it when it hits escalation.



The Weekly Rhythm That Needs to Run Itself



Currently there's a manual weekly structure that keeps getting missed:





Monday — Review tracker, surface what needs action this week

Tuesday — Chase brands on missing briefs, contracts, approvals

Wednesday — Prompt talent coordination: insights, timelines, drafts

Thursday — Send content drafts to brands for approval

Friday — Audit invoices and payment status





I want this rhythm automated — the right notifications going to the right people on the right days, with escalation to me only when something is overdue or stuck.



What I Want From You





An honest assessment of our current tools — should we stay on Google Sheets and Protonmail, or would a different stack make this dramatically easier? I want your opinion, not just whatever works with what we have.

The automations built and tested — covering the full deal lifecycle above, with proper error handling so I know when something breaks.

Clear documentation — I need to understand what you've built well enough to maintain it or brief someone else on it. No black boxes.

A handover that actually works — walk me through it, make sure it runs, and be available for a week after handover to fix anything that surfaces in real use.





What I Don't Need





Overengineered solutions for simple problems

Anything that requires a developer to maintain long-term

Someone who builds to impress rather than to work





Budget and Timeline





Fixed project fee — please quote based on the scope above

Expected timeline: 2–4 weeks

Happy to pay properly for clean, reliable work





To Apply





Tell me what tools you'd recommend for this setup and why — based on what I've described, not what you usually default to

A screenshot or Loom of an automation you've built that involves multi-stage workflows with conditional chasing or follow-ups

One thing in the workflow above that you'd do differently — I want to know you've actually read it and thought about it

title: Executive assistant
description:
Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant — Inbox, Systems & Focus Management for a Busy Founder



Type: Full-time, remote (Philippines) Pay: $800–$1,300/month, based on experience (open to discussion for the right fit) Start: ASAP



About the role



We sell sustainable bottled water (consumer packaged goods) in retail stores across New Zealand, Australia and USA



I'm a founder who moves fast and juggles a lot — around 50
s a day, several live projects, and a habit of jumping between ideas before finishing them. I'm looking for an experienced EA/PA who's done this before and can walk in with real systems, not someone I need to train from scratch.



Your core job is to give me long, uninterrupted blocks of focused work time by owning everything that would otherwise pull my attention — my inbox, my task follow-through, and the systems that keep my work organized. You'll triage what's urgent, file what isn't, chase down the things I start and abandon, and build the structure that makes my day-to-day run without me having to hold it all in my head.



This is not a "wait for instructions" role. I want someone who sees a mess and already knows three ways to fix it, then tells me which one they recommend.



What you'll actually do



Inbox and communications management



Triage 50+
s a day: flag what's truly urgent, draft or send replies to routine ones, file or archive the rest.

Build (or bring) a labeling/folder system so nothing important gets buried and I never have to "dig."

Give me a short daily summary of what needs my attention — not a raw inbox dump.

Protect my focus blocks: nothing reaches me during deep work unless it's genuinely time-sensitive.



Task and project follow-through



When I start something and go quiet on it — say I
 one manufacturer about a deal and then get pulled away — you catch it, log it, and keep it moving. Follow up, gather next steps, and bring it back to me at the right 
nt instead of letting it die in my inbox.

Keep a live tracker of everything "in motion" so nothing I care about falls through the cracks.

Help me plan my 1–3 big tasks for the day and hold the line on protecting time for them.



Systems and organization



Assess how I currently work and propose better systems — task management, file organization, information storage — so I stop repeating myself and you (or I) can always find what's needed in seconds.

Build and maintain SOPs/templates for recurring work so things run consistently even when I'm not involved.

Own the "single source of truth" for my ongoing projects, contacts, and open loops.



Growth into broader support (bonus, not day-one requirement)



Light outreach: researching and contacting potential customers, suppliers, manufacturers, or distributors on my behalf.

Picking up a thread I've started (e.g., "find an Australian manufacturer for X") and running it to completion or a clear next decision point.

Other ad hoc research and admin as trust builds.



Who I'm looking for



2+ years of experience as an EA, PA, or Chief of Staff-type role, ideally supporting a founder, executive, or otherwise fast-moving/scattered client.

You've dealt with a high-volume inbox before and have your own method for taming it — you can describe it in the interview without prompting.

You're a systems thinker: you default to "let's build a process for this" rather than solving the same problem manually every time.

Comfortable managing ambiguity and half-finished threads — you can take a vague or dropped task and turn it into a completed one.

Strong written English and excellent follow-up discipline — things don't slip through with you.

Proactive: you bring me options and recommendations, not just questions. I don't want to micromanage; I want to hand you a problem and trust you'll either solve it or tell me clearly what you need fro
.

Bonus: experience with
 outreach, lead generation, or light sales/vendor research.

Bonus: experience working with founders or clients who are ADHD/high-context-switching — you understand why protecting focus time matters and won't take it personally when I'm heads-down.

Big bonus: background in food & beverage or CPG (consumer packaged goods) — you understand supplier/distributor/manufacturer relationships, product sourcing, or retail/DTC operations, even if your title wasn't in that industry directly.

Big bonus: real, provable social media experience — not just scheduling posts, but strategy, content, and results you can point to (growth numbers, campaigns you ran end-to-end). I'd rather hear "here's what I actually built and what happened" than a list of platforms you've touched.

Bonus: exposure to the NZ, US, and/or AU markets — time zone overlap, client experience, or general familiarity with how business is done there.



Tools you should be comfortable with (or learn fast)



Gmail/Google Workspace, a task manager (Asana/ClickUp/Notion/Trello — tell me what you prefer and why), and general cloud file organization (Google Drive). Familiarity with automation tools (Zapier, etc.) is a plus but not required.



How to apply



Please include:



A short note on how you currently structure your day/inbox management system for a busy client — give me a real example.

A specific example of a time you caught a "dropped" task or project and got it back on track without being asked.

Your relevant experience (years, type of clients/executives supported) and availability (hours/timezone overlap).

Any food & beverage, CPG, or physical-product background (sourcing, suppliers, distribution, retail/DTC) — and/or genuine social media experience with real results, if you have either. Not required, but tell me if you do.

Your expected monthly salary.



Applications without a real example of your system (not just "I'm organized and detail-oriented") will not be considered — I want to see how you think, not a generic pitch.

title: VA - Product Testing Assistant
description:
Start your application with MANGO.



We need a part-time VA / product testing assistant for Carby, a carb-conscious meal planning app. This is practical user-flow testing and evidence organization, not generic design opinions.



Paid test assignment:

- Submit the test here: 

- First record a 3 minute web app tech check on a phone browser with microphone audio.

- Then record a separate iPhone app review if you have real iPhone access.

- Use the test web app URL: 
 and start from the beginning of the normal funnel. Do not skip directly to checkout.

- If checkout asks for payment, use Stripe test card
with any future expiry, any CVC, and any ZIP/postal code.

- Follow instructions exactly, think out loud while testing, organize your findings clearly, and include a Google Doc with video links, repro steps, severity, and what confused you.

- Test in two modes: robot mode follows the exact normal flow; chaos mode tries to break real-user intent with realistic cases like in-app browser, old account, already subscribed account, app already installed, reinstall, slow connection, double taps, refresh, app switch, and kill/reopen.

- Focus on previously unknown issues that could hurt quiz completion, checkout trust, payment, activation, retention, meal-plan use, grocery-list use, or trust.

- Paywall clarity: do not answer whether you personally would buy. Narrate what you believe is happening: am I paying today, when will I be charged, how much, can I cancel, and what happens after I install?

- Paid handoff/sign-in is critical: after checkout/trial, test app install/open/sign-in/access. If possible, cover iOS Safari, Instagram browser, TikTok browser, already-installed app, and not-installed app.

- Vague reports like 'it did not work' need exact screen/action, repro context, and session ID or account identifier if available.

- Include one final answer: what is the single 
nt most likely to make a real user quit before getting a useful meal plan/grocery list?

- Include the word crispy in the severity section so we know you read the instructions.



Good assistants are detail-oriented, can follow a checklist, record narrated evidence, organize links/docs cleanly, and explain exactly where a user got confused or stuck.

Bad submissions are broad opinions, silent recordings, old portfolio samples, skipped instructions, or minor polish with no user-flow impact.

title: Advertising & Sales Representative
description:
## About Summer House Media Co.



Summer House Media Co. is a growing media company focused on creating, managing, and supporting purposeful media, advertising, and growth opportunities across digital, print, content, client-service, and community-centered channels.



The company is structured through departments and flexible business clusters. Departments define the functional area of a role, while clusters represent active business priorities, projects, products, offers, or client-service areas.



This role sits within the Sales Department and may support sales-related work across different clusters as the company grows. Depending on business needs, this role may support coaching program sales, appointment setting, client outreach, advertising sales support, lead generation, account management, follow-up, CRM tracking, or other revenue-related projects.



## Role Overview



The Sales & Account Support Virtual Assistant supports the front-end and middle stages of the sales and client-development process across Summer House Media Co. and related business clusters.



This person helps identify qualified prospects, initiate conversations, follow up with interested leads, maintain CRM records, schedule appointments, support account communication, and help move prospects toward the appropriate next step.



This is not a passive administrative role. The right person must be comfortable with outreach, follow-up, written communication, relationship-building, pipeline tracking, and helping convert interest into action.



The first major assignment for this role may include supporting sales for **Make Your Move: A 6-Week Faith-Informed Clarity Intensive**, a coaching program offered through The Sprout Community. Over time, this role may also support other Summer House Media Co. sales, advertising, client service, partnership, or account-management priorities.



## Role Purpose



The purpose of this role is to help Summer House Media Co. and its related clusters build organized, consistent, and relationship-driven sales support systems.



This role helps ensure that strong leads are identified, conversations are started, follow-ups are completed, appointments are booked, CRM records are accurate, and prospects receive clear next steps.



The Sales & Account Support VA helps prevent leads from falling through the cracks and supports the company’s ability to grow revenue through consistent outreach, organized follow-up, and professional communication.





## Initial Focus Area: Make Your Move Program Sales Support



One potential focus of this role will be supporting sales and enrollment for **Make Your Move: A 6-Week Faith-Informed Clarity Intensive** through The Sprout Community.



The Sprout Community is a faith-informed personal and professional development brand helping high-achieving professionals move from overthinking to aligned action.



Make Your Move is designed for professionals who know they have outgrown their current chapter but feel stuck between comfort and conviction. The program helps participants stop circling, discern clearly, make the decision they have been avoiding, and execute with confidence, courage, and stewardship.



When assigned to this cluster, the Sales & Account Support VA will help identify, connect with, qualify, and follow up with prospective participants who may be a strong fit for the program.



## Key Responsibilities



### Lead Research and Prospecting



* Research potential leads who align with assigned offers, campaigns, programs, services, or client opportunities.

* Identify prospects through approved platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram,
 groups, event communities, professional networks,
 lists, prior lead lists, and other approved sources.

* Build and maintain organized lead lists with accurate contact information, notes, qualification details, source information, and follow-up status.

* Prioritize leads based on alignment with the target audience, readiness, need, offer fit, and likelihood of taking action.

* Research high-achieving professionals, emerging entrepreneurs, career pivoters, creators, founders, purpose-driven leaders, small business owners, or other assigned audience segments.

* Identify warm leads from past events,
 engagement, social media interaction, referrals, prior conversations, or existing community relationships.



### Outbound Outreach



* Send personalized outreach messages using approved scripts, templates, and brand voice guidelines.

* Adapt outreach based on the prospect’s background, interests, business, goals, or likely pain points.

* Start conversations around the relevant offer, opportunity, program, service, or next step.

* Represent the company and related brands with professionalism, warmth, confidence, clarity, and care.

* Avoid spammy, generic, misleading, hype-based, or overly aggressive messaging.

* Track outreach activity clearly, including date contacted, platform used, message sent, response received, and next step.



### Lead Qualification



* Engage prospects in conversation to understand goals, challenges, timing, fit, and level of interest.

* Identify whether a prospect appears ready for the offer, service, program, appointment, discovery call, or next step.

* Ask thoughtful qualification questions using approved language and scripts.

* Track qualification notes accurately and respectfully.

* Identify prospects who may need nurturing, follow-up, additional information, or a different offer.

* Escalate strong leads, concerns, questions, or unusual situations to the appropriate lead or founder.



### Appointment Setting and Next-Step Conversion



* Invite qualified leads to book a discovery call, apply, attend an info session, request details, schedule a consultation, or take another approved next step.

* Help maintain 
ntum with interested leads so conversations do not go cold.

* Follow up with warm leads who have expressed interest but have not yet taken action.

* Calendar, confirm, and remind prospects about scheduled calls or next steps when assigned.

* Support the movement of prospects from interest to booked appointment, submitted application, confirmed call, or qualified sales conversation.

* Ensure leads receive clear, accurate, and timely next-step instructions.



### CRM and Pipeline Management



* Maintain organized lead trackers, CRM records, pipeline documents, or sales dashboards.

* Update lead status, outreach history, follow-up dates, call bookings, notes, objections, and qualification details.

* Keep all lead information accurate, current, and easy for leadership or sales leads to review.

* Track follow-up tasks so no strong lead is missed.

* Support pipeline visibility by keeping records clean, organized, and updated.

s, applications, program information, or social media.

* Send reminders, next-step messages, application nudges, appointment confirmations, and nurture messages using approved language.

* Share feedback from prospects, including common objections, questions, hesitations, language patterns, and themes.

* Help identify patterns in who is responding and what messaging is resonating.

* Assist with light account-management support, including client or lead follow-up, information requests, reminder messages, status tracking, or relationship-nurture tasks.

### Make Your Move Messaging Expectations



When assigned to the Make Your Move cluster, the Sales & Account Support VA must understand that The Sprout Community is not positioned as a general networking community or casual event brand.



The messaging behind Make Your Move is centered on:



* Decision over delay

* Courage over comfort

* Stewardship over stagnation

* Faith with works

* Clarity through action

* Execution, not intention



Communication should be clear, grounded, warm, professional, and direct. It should not be pushy, vague, overly casual, manipulative, or hype-based.



## Success Metrics



Success in this role may be measured by:



* Number of qualified leads researched

* Number of personalized outreach messages sent

* Response rate from outreach

* Number of qualified conversations started

* Number of discovery calls, applications, consultations, or appointments generated

* Follow-up consistency

* CRM accuracy

* Leads researched

* Messages sent

* Responses received

* Qualified leads identified

* Discovery calls, applications, consultations, or appointments generated

* Follow-ups completed

* Follow-ups still pending

* Common objections or questions from prospects

* Lead sources or audience segments performing well

* Recommendations for improving outreach

* Support needed from leadership or the sales lead



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Confident in written communication

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable with outbound outreach and follow-up

* Able to take initiative without constant supervision

* Warm, professional, and direct

* Interested in personal development, coaching, entrepreneurship, media, sales, faith-informed growth, or purpose-driven work

, and scheduling platforms

* Comfortable working with a founder-led and growing company

* Sales support

This role helps Summer House Media Co. and its related brands grow through consistent, thoughtful, and organized sales support.



Whether supporting Make Your Move, a client-service offer, advertising opportunity, sponsorship campaign, or another sales-related project, this person helps connect the right people to the right next step.

title: Social Media Content VA
description:
The Role



We're a pre-launch clean pet grooming brand building an audience with ingredient-education video. The founder films herself and records voiceovers; you handle everything else, sourcing the visuals, building the graphics, editing, scheduling, posting, and community. The goal is that the founder is NOT tracking down images or assets; you are. You're organized, resourceful, and good at turning a founder's raw clips and a fact sheet into a polished, scroll-stopping video.



What you'll do



-Edit raw footage into finished Reels, TikToks, and Shorts: cuts, captions, text overlays, trending audio, and a strong hook in the first 2 seconds.

-Build videos in two formats: (1) the founder's voiceover played over ingredient labels and info visuals, and (2) the founder talking to camera with info graphics running in the background.

-Source the visuals so the founder doesn't have to: find ingredient-label images and product photos to feature, plus relevant b-roll and stock images (mindful of usage rights).

-Create and add on-screen graphics: green / yellow / red flag indicators, EWG score callouts, simple info cards, and text overlays, from the founder's fact sheets.

-Write captions and hashtags in brand voice (playful, warm, educational) from the founder's talking points.

-Schedule and post across Instagram and TikTok (plus Pinterest / YouTube Shorts repurposing) on an agreed calendar.

-Light community management: reply to comments and DMs in brand voice, and flag anything that needs the founder.

-Maintain a shared asset library, raw footage in, finished assets out, plus saved label images, product shots, and reusable graphic templates, so nothing gets re-hunted.

-Send a simple monthly performance snapshot: reach, follower growth, saves/shares, top posts, and
 signups driven from social.



You should have

-A portfolio of short-form videos you've edited (Reels / TikToks). This is the #1 requirement.

-Strong short-form editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar).

-Graphic and simple motion-graphics ability (Canva, CapCut, or After Effects) for on-screen flags, score callouts, and info cards.

-Resourcefulness at sourcing images, product photos, and stock footage, and awareness of usage rights.

-Good caption writing and a feel for hooks, trends, and hashtags on Instagram and TikTok.

-Experience with a scheduling tool (Later, Metricool, Planoly, or Buffer).

-Reliability and proactive communication. You hit the posting cadence without being chased.

Nice to have

-Pet, lifestyle, or clean-beauty / DTC brand experience.

-Community management experience and light analytics reporting.



Logistics



-Hours: ~10–15 per week to start, growing toward launch. [Adjust]

-Tools: shared Google Drive/Dropbox for footage and assets, a scheduling tool, Canva/CapCut. Brand voice guide and ingredient fact sheets provided.

-Cadence to support: about 4 short videos per week plus daily stories, repurposed across platforms.

-Weekly check-in with the founder.

-Compensation: Please share your rate and availability.



Brand voice guardrails (you'll get a full guide)



-Human and warm. No AI-sounding copy, and no em dashes.

-Cosmetic/grooming claims only. Never medical or drug claims (no 'cures,' 'treats,' 'heals').

-Educate about ingredients and categories. Never name or criticize specific competitor brands unless the founder has cleared it.

-EWG wording: 'formulated with EWG 1–2 rated ingredients.' Never say 'EWG Verified' (we're not certified yet).

-Use only the founder's approved fact sheets for any ingredient claim, and route anything uncertain to the founder before posting.



To apply



Send your portfolio (2–3 short-form videos you edited, ideally some with on-screen graphics), your rate, your weekly availability, and one sentence on why clean pet care appeals to you.

title: UI/UX Designer (B2B SaaS)
description:
UI/UX Designer (B2B SaaS)

Company: WorkWise Auto Solutions

Remote: Philippines



About WorkWise Auto Solutions

WorkWise Auto Solutions is transforming how automotive workshops operate. We help shop owners streamline their workflow, reduce administrative stress, and increase profitability through a combination of smart systems and human support.

Our core service revolves around Virtual Service Advisors (VSAs) who handle customer communication, booking triage, job approvals, and workflow optimisation. We also build internal tools, marketing assets, and client-facing platforms to support that mission, and that’s where you come in.





If you have ever sat in a project watching developers make the design decisions, knowing you could have made the product genuinely better if someone had just handed you the keys, this role was written for you.

We are upgrading our Elite Platform, a software platform used by Australian auto workshops, and we are looking for one designer to own how it looks and how it works, from the first wireframe to the final build-ready file.

Right now, our developers are designing as they build. It works, but it means constant revisions and a look that drifts from screen to screen. We want someone to step in and bring it all together into one clear, consistent, genuinely usable product. The users are real mechanics and service advisors with grease on their hands and no patience for clutter, so the work is about clarity and flow, not decoration.

This starts as a 3-month full-time project to design and ship Elite V2. When you prove this is your thing, it becomes a permanent role, with you owning the look and feel of everything we build from then on.



This is you

- You have designed real B2B SaaS or web apps, and Figma feels like home.

- You look at a cluttered, complicated screen and you actually enjoy finding the simple version hiding inside it.

- You design for the person using the product, not to impress other designers, and you can explain the thinking behind a choice instead of just saying it looks better.

- You have opinions, and you hold them lightly. Feedback makes your work sharper, not defensive.

- You think in systems. Sitemaps, navigation, and a clean component library are how your mind already works.

- You are done with short gigs. You want somewhere to settle in, take ownership, and watch something get better because of you.

If you read that and felt a quiet yes, keep going. 



What you will do day to day

- Turn our team’s ideas into complete, ready-to-build designs.

- Create wireframes and high-fidelity clickable prototypes in Figma.

- Build and maintain a design system so every screen feels like part of the same product.

- Design clear layouts for data-heavy screens like tables, dashboards, scheduling calendars, inventory, and financial reports.

- Make designs work beautifully across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

- Hand developers clean files, assets, and documentation they can build from accurately.

- Run simple usability checks so problems get caught before a line of code is written.



One real 
nt from the role

The messy workflow

A workshop needs to invoice one repair job that involved three different parts, two mechanics, and a follow-up booking. The developers hand you a cluttered screen with everything crammed in. How do you redesign it so a busy service advisor reads it in seconds and misses nothing?

If your mind has already started solving that, picturing the layout, d
 what to cut, you are the person we are looking for. That instinct matters to us far more than a polished resume.



Why you will like it here

- You own the whole product, not a corner of it. The design is yours to shape.

- 100% remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

- Australian day-shift hours, so your evenings and your family time stay yours.

- Competitive pay in AUD, paid straight to your bank account.

- Real growth. Strong performers move from project work into a permanent, long-term role.

- A team that respects clear thinking and good design, and actually listens to its designer.



What you will need

- Solid experience designing B2B SaaS or web apps. A portfolio link is required.

- Expert-level Figma, with wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and developer handoff.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- A reliable computer that runs Figma smoothly, a stable internet (tell us your real speed), and a quiet space for calls.



How to apply

Applications are only reviewed through the form below, not by

Two things we read first, so please do not skip them:

description:
Responsibilities



Market & bench building

*Build and continuously expand TriArc’s qualified trade partner database by trade, geography, capacity, and performance.

*Run ongoing prequalification (financials, safety, workload, bonding) in coordination with Accounting.



Bid strategy & scheduling

*Publish the rolling Bid Calendar; align milestones with Estimators/PMs and owners/architects.

*Break down drawings/specs into clear trade packages; assign scope sheets and alternates.



ITB execution

*Prepare Invitation to Bid packages (drawings, specs, addenda, bid forms, alternates, due dates, delivery method).

*Post to BuildingConnected; segment targeted lists; personalize top-tier outreach.



Relentless follow-up

*3-touch cadence (Day 1

*Track interest/no-bid reasons; backfill gaps early; escalate risk areas to Estimating.



Bid intake & leveling

*Receive bids, confirm inclusions/exclusions, and level against scope sheets; flag outliers and VE options.

*Package a clean Bid Leveling Matrix for Estimators/PMs with award recommendation.



Data & feedback loops

*Score and rate trade partner performance post-award (price accuracy, quality, safety, schedule).

*Run post-bid debriefs; capture lessons learned to refine future ITBs.



Brand & relationship

*Be TriArc’s front door for subs: fast answers, fair process, respectful communication, and values-based partnership.

As a Virtual Assistant (Admin Support), you will:

• Assist with administrative tasks such as data entry, scheduling, and
 management
