s, voice calls, or other communications handled by the financial advisers.

• Ensure all documents are accurately identified, filed, and kept up to date, using sound understanding of complex and detailed information to support effective filing.

• Prepare reports and support the creation of key documents—such as court submissions, correspondence, and letters —to assist in management decision-making.

• Monitor multiple inboxes to keep financial advisers across their tasks by organising
s, flagging important messages, and drafting appropriate replies as needed.

• Provide strategic support and innovative recommendations during the planning and implementation of marketing activities.

• Make recommendations to improve systems and processes.

• Maintain regular communication with our Australian counterparts to ensure timely work completion and seamless business operations.

• Perform to the best of his/her abilities all functions, duties and responsibilities to be assigned by Aeran in due course.

• Perform any other administrative or non-administrative duties as assigned by any of Aeran’s representatives from time to time through direct written order or by verbal assignment.



Qualifications & Skills We're Looking For:

• Proven Experience: A minimum of three years' experience in an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar administrative role is highly desirable.

• Initiative: We need someone who can anticipate needs, act proactively, and take ownership of tasks without constant supervision.

• Attention to Detail: Meticulous and accurate in all tasks, especially with financial records and data.

• Resourcefulness: Ability to find solutions, research information effectively, and problem-solve independently.

This includes an unpaid meal break of 60 minutes for each full shift, or such other normal working hours as may be prescribed by Aeran from time to time.

title: Bookkeeper / Tax Associate
description:
Job Description:



We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and client-focused professional to join our accounting team as an Associate. In this role, you will provide comprehensive support in business taxation, financial recordkeeping and bookkeeping, notice defense, and other tax and accounting services for a variety of clients across many different industries. 

You will play a key role in helping clients stay financially organized and compliant, while building strong and lasting relationships based on trust and accuracy in a multi-disciplinary firm.

This position requires strong attention to detail, proficiency in accounting software, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, service-driven environment. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about supporting small businesses and delivering high-quality, dependable financial services.



Key Responsibilities:

• Prepare and file business tax returns (e.g., corporate, partnership, sales/use tax) in compliance with applicable laws and deadlines

• Respond to tax notices and assist clients in resolving tax-related issues or discrepancies

• Coordinate with external tax authorities or agencies as needed

• Support clients during audits by preparing and organizing required documentation

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records for clients, including income, expenses, and supporting documentation

• Record day-to-day financial transactions such as purchases, receipts, sales, and payments

We are hiring a remote Sales Development Representative / Appointment Setter to help introduce Rental Prop Finder to realtors, brokerages, investor focused agents, property managers, and real estate investors.



Rental Prop Finder is a rental property intelligence platform that helps users find, analyze, save, track, and evaluate rental property opportunities using property data, rent insights, FMR data, market analysis, and team collaboration tools.



Your role will be to call leads inside our CRM, explain the product in simple terms, qualify interest, book demos, send follow ups, and keep CRM records updated.



Responsibilities:



Make outbound calls to realtor, brokerage, property manager, and investor lists



Use our call script and improve it based on real conversations



Book qualified demos for the founder or sales team



Send follow up
s and messages through the CRM



Log every call, note, objection, and next step accurately



Identify prospects who may be a good fit for individual, brokerage, or team accounts



Communicate clearly with the team about what prospects are saying



Requirements:



Strong spoken English



Previous cold calling, appointment setting, ISA, SDR, real estate, SaaS, or B2B sales experience



Comfortable making high volume outbound calls



Able to work during U.S. business hours



Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and headset



Experience using a CRM



Organized, coachable, consistent, and comfortable with rejection



Bonus points:



Real estate cold calling experience



Experience calling realtors, brokerages, property managers, or investors



Experience selling software, subscriptions, marketing tools, or lead generation tools



Familiarity with HubSpot



Compensation:



Hourly base plus performance bonuses



Bonus paid for qualified demos held



Additional bonus opportunities for paid customers sourced from your outreach



To apply:



Send a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit



Describe your cold calling or appointment setting experience



Tell us what CRM tools you have used



Confirm your availability during U.S. business hours

title: Senior Bookkeeper for a US Firm — QuickBooks + Payroll, Full-Time, PST Hours, Long-Term Home
description:
Read this before you apply. This is not a data-entry seat you rotate out of in six months. We are building a finance team we plan to keep for years. We are looking for the person who becomes the backbone of it.



WHO WE ARE



We are Growing Pro CFO, a US firm that helps Christian business owners know their numbers and grow their profit. Owners come to us for clarity and accountability. You are the person who keeps their books clean and accurate so our CFO advisor can sit across from them and help them win. Your work is the foundation the whole relationship stands on.



WHY THIS SEAT IS DIFFERENT



Most bookkeeping jobs bury you in a backlog and never let you see the impact. Here you own the books for real clients. You see the profit leaks you help catch. You sit inside a firm that treats you like an A-player, not a task rabbit. We give you full access to the tools, the systems, and the AI that makes the work faster. You bring the judgment.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Full monthly bookkeeping for our clients in QuickBooks Online. Categorize, reconcile, close.

- Bank and credit card reconciliations that tie out to the penny.

- Payroll runs through QuickBooks Payroll, ADP, or Gusto, on time, every cycle.

- Client-ready reports every month. Profit and loss, balance sheet, and the key numbers our advisor walks the client through.

- Catching the things that matter and flagging them early, before they show up on a client call.



WHO YOU ARE



- A CPA, or a seasoned bookkeeper with real US experience. You know US-based books, not just local.

- Fluent in QuickBooks Online. Comfortable running payroll in QuickBooks, ADP, or Gusto.

- Strong written English. You can explain a number clearly.

- You know how to work with AI. You already use it, or you are hungry to, and you see it as leverage.

- You can work Monday to Friday, 6am to 3pm Pacific time. This is required, because you work alongside our US team.

- You take ownership. When something is off, you dig in and fix it. You do not wait to be told.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time, long-term, stable. We are building, not experimenting.

- Competitive pay for a top bookkeeper, based on your experience.

- 13th month pay.

- Paid time off and real rest. We believe in stewardship, not burnout.

- Raises tied to your growth. As we grow, the person who helped build it grows first. There is a path to lead the finance team.

- A team that respects your craft and gives you the tools to be great.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word STEWARD at the very top, so we know you read this.

2. Record a short Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes, and paste the link. Tell us three things: why we should hire you, your US bookkeeping and payroll experience, and one time you caught a mistake nobody else noticed. Keep it simple. We care about how you think and communicate, not production quality. Loom is free at loom.com. If you cannot use Loom, any webcam or screen recording link works.

3. List your years in QuickBooks Online and whether you are a CPA.

4. Confirm you can work 6am to 3pm Pacific, Monday to Friday.



We read every application that starts with the code word and includes a video. We reply to the ones that fit. We look forward to meeting you.

title: 24 HR Review | VA Remote Virtual Receptionist
description:
Important: Selected applicants will receive a response within 24 hours. Due to the volume of applications, we may move forward with other candidates if we do not receive a timely response.



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance. 



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a voice-based role, we also offer non-voice positions with a heavier focus on administrative tasks, subject to availability and overall fit.



To apply: Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly.



(1) Where in the Philippines are you currently located? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



(2) Please submit a screenshot of your internet speed and a few samples of your previous work output.  



(3) Please submit two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. 



(4) Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



(5) Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired.   



(6) Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, explain the exact step-by-step process you followed, the tools or systems used, and the typical result or output produced.



(7) If you were hired today, what are 3 specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: We sincerely invite long-term cooperation as we have a consistent, large-scale demand for Filipino online ESL teachers.
description:
We are an educational institution with over ten years of industry experience and a large stable student base. As our business continues to expand, we have launched a new online English tutoring platform. We are now recruiting a large number of qualified online English teachers from the Philippines.

We sincerely extend a cooperation invitation to headhunters and agencies with high-quality, stable and large-scale teacher resources. We welcome partnership discussions to achieve resource complementarity and long-term win-win cooperation.



Recruitment Requirements

1.Able to steadily supply Filipino teachers in bulk, flexibly adjust the number of candidates according to our needs, and support long-term continuous cooperation.

2.All provided Filipino teachers must have fluent oral English proficiency and hold official teaching certifications such as TESOL or TEFL .

3.Teachers are required to have one-on-one English teaching experience (online teaching experience is preferred). They should be skilled in one-on-one teaching for kids and children, with excellent classroom interaction and communication abilities.

4.Cooperate with us in arranging trial lessons and qualification verification to ensure authentic personal information and qualified teaching capabilities.



Our Cooperation Advantages

1.Stable & High Demand: We own a large student group with consistent booking needs throughout morning, afternoon and evening peak hours.

2.Efficient Cooperation Process: Dedicated communication channel and exclusive staff for screening and follow-up. Transparent review procedures greatly improve cooperation efficiency.

3.Guaranteed Commission Payment: Commission is settled per successfully onboarded teacher, paid every two weeks with no payment delays.

4.Long-term In-depth Collaboration: Exclusive partnership will be established for outstanding partners with high-quality resources and efficient services, with priority access to all our recruitment demands.



Requirements for Partners

1.Individual recruiters or formal agencies with direct access to Filipino teacher resources, no multi-level intermediaries, ensuring stable supply and reasonable cost.

2.Capable of preliminary screening, including qualification checks and oral assessments, to provide pre-qualified candidates and reduce communication costs for both sides.

3.Cooperate with trial lesson assessments, pre-service training arrangements, and daily coordination such as schedule adjustments and basic issue feedback.

4.Uphold integrity in cooperation. Ensure all teacher information and certifications are authentic; no fake credentials or inexperienced teachers shall be recommended. All cooperation terms must be strictly followed.

5.Conduct internal screening to exclude teachers with poor work attitude and inactive communication habits.

6.Serious inquiries only.



Cooperation Scope & Services

1.Partners provide bulk resumes and basic information of Filipino teachers that meet our standards in terms of quantity, teaching experience and course adaptability.

2.After we complete resume screening and online interviews to confirm employment, partners assist with follow-up onboarding coordination.

3.Partners maintain daily basic communication with teachers to ensure smooth teaching operations.

4.Both sides conduct regular reviews to adjust teacher supply quantity and optimize cooperation procedures according to business development.



Cooperation Process

1.Demand Communication: Partners contact us and introduce their resource scale, teacher qualifications and supply capacity; both parties confirm detailed cooperation terms and models.

2.Resource Verification: Partners send sample teacher profiles for our qualification review and trial lessons to verify overall resource quality.

3.Trial Cooperation: Start small-scale trial cooperation to run in workflows. After confirming teaching quality and service performance, formal long-term bulk recruitment cooperation will be launched with commission settlement executed as agreed.



Note

Interested partners please attach a brief introduction of your Filipino teacher resources (scale, certification proportion, supply capacity, etc.) when contacting us for quick review and follow-up arrangement.

ROLE OVERVIEW



This is a part-time role (4 hours per day / 20 hours per week), with the potential to transition into a full-time position over time. We are targeting a start date ASAP.



The successful candidate must be available to work during evening/graveyard hours aligned with Arizona (MST) time zone.

This role requires someone who can anticipate needs, identify problems before they arise, and provide solutions independently.



------

s with resources

**
 campaigns and execution: Support and manage
 campaigns and sequences created by the co-owners

REQUIREMENTS



** 4–5+ years experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar role

** Strong expertise in GoHighLevel (GHL), including navigation, workflows, and integrations

** Experience with inbox and calendar management at an executive level

** Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) for productivity and communication

** Proficiency in Notion (creating, structuring, and maintaining SOPs and internal documentation)

** Strong research skills (e.g., podcast outreach, data gathering, verification)

** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

** Highly proactive, organized, and detail-oriented

** Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



WORK SETUP



** Part-time: 4 hours per day (20 hours per week)

** Schedule: Evening / Graveyard shift (Arizona – MST time zone)

** Start date: Mid-May to third week of May

** Potential to transition into a full-time role



HOW TO APPLY



To submit your application, please send the following:



** Updated CV

Please send your application to:

My job is to create great content.



Your job is to make sure every video looks professional and gets published.



I am not looking for a freelancer that I have to manage every day.



I am looking for a long-term teammate who wants to own the entire YouTube production process. I don't care if you personally touch every singly piece of the process (outsource as you desire) but I want you to OWN the whole process so I do not have to think about it.



If you enjoy YouTube, appreciate high-quality work, and love building systems, I would love to hear from you.



## What You'll Do ##



For every long-form video, you will:



* Edit the video into a polished YouTube episode (or outsource at your own expense)

* Improve audio quality.

* Add B-roll, graphics, zooms, captions, and simple animations when appropriate.

* Design a clean, professional thumbnail (or outsource at your own expense)

* Write three title options.

* Draft the YouTube description using AI.

* Add chapters and timestamps.

* Create two YouTube Shorts.

* Upload everything to YouTube as a draft.

* Organize all project files in Dropbox.

* Help improve our workflow over time.



Typical workload:



* Up to 12 long-form YouTube videos per month.

* 24  Shorts per month.

* Thumbnail for every video.

* Upload and publish management.



## What Success Looks Like



I want to be able to record a video, upload it once, and never think about it again until I receive a YouTube draft that's ready for review.



If you enjoy taking ownership and making things better without being asked, you'll thrive in this role.



## Hiring Process



The hiring process is straightforward:



* Short application review.

* Paid editing test.

* Final interview.

* Job offer.



The paid editing test will include one raw video. You'll edit it, create a thumbnail, write titles and descriptions, add chapters, and produce two Shorts. We will pay every finalist for their time. I will pay you $100 for this.



## One Last Thing



I care far more about reliability, communication, ownership, and attention to detail than fancy editing effects.



If you're the type of person who notices small mistakes, enjoys improving processes, and takes pride in producing work that feels polished, we'd love to work with you for many years.

title: Creative Marketer & Content Builder (AI-Powered) | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
I run a fast-growing AI consulting business serving high-profile entrepreneurs in the German-speaking market, people with 7 to 8-figure yearly revenue. My developers can take on more clients than I can currently bring in. The bottleneck is me: I don't have the time or the head space to post every day, research trends, or write newsletters. That's not my job, it's yours.



I'm looking for one person who owns my marketing and turns attention into leads. Your single goal: get more of the right people to know me, so they become clients. Followers and views are nice, but they are not the point. Leads are the point.



**Who you'll work with**



You won't be alone. You'll join a small, tight team and work directly with me. I already have strong AI skills, my writing voice built into tools, and stacks of my call and coaching transcripts you'll pull from. The strategy direction comes fro
 and two senior marketing coaches I work with. You bring the creativity, the ideas, and the output. Lots of freedom from day one. You come to me daily with what you'd do, in most cases I'll say yes.



**What you will do**



- Write my LinkedIn posts: research trends, pull angles from my transcripts, write 1 to 2 posts per day in my voice (AI-assisted)

- Create the visuals for each post: strong, scroll-stopping images, made yourself or with AI

- Turn one piece of content into many: take a topic and cut it for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and a blog

- Write
 newsletters, WhatsApp broadcasts, and landing-page copy for lead magnets

- Market our lead magnets and drive people into my
 list and WhatsApp: we build the lead magnets (they're mostly custom skills), you handle the promotion. Build the landing pages with AI, write the posts, run the full lead chain, and tell us which lead magnets would land with this audience

- Bring ideas every day. You have a lot of creative freedom and I want you to use it.



All output is German, but you don't need to speak German. You work in English and use AI to translate both ways. That's a solved problem.



**What matters most to me**



You understand my audience. That's the whole game.



My clients are successful, busy entrepreneurs. Everyone wants a piece of their attention. So the person I hire has to respect their time and know exactly what this audience wants to see and what they don't. Serious, professional, high-value content. I need someone who has built personal brands for a serious, premium audience. Not someone whose "viral" work is cat videos.



If a design isn't 100% perfect once in a while, nobody at this level will hold it against me. What kills me is content that misreads the audience. Get the audience right, and the money follows.



I care about quantity you can keep up consistently. The quality bar on strategy I handle. You keep the volume of posts, images, and newsletters flowing.



**Must-have**



- Experience building personal brands for a serious, professional, premium audience (proof required)

- Strong creative sense: you come up with ideas, angles, and visuals, you don't wait to be told

- Can create scroll-stopping images with AI (this is a big plus, see below)

- Comfortable using AI tools daily to research, write, translate, and design (Mainly Claude AI)

- Writes excellent English copy that converts

- Works structured, hits a daily output rhythm, brings proposals proactively

- Honest and reliable



**A big plus**



- AI design: building landing pages and images with AI. This is our biggest gap right now. If you can design with AI, you move to the top of the pile.

- SEO / GEO understanding: building blog content that raises my visibility in search and in AI answers

- Video editing: later I want to build AI-avatar reels of me, daily, edited by you and posted to Instagram



**Where this grows**



This role grows fast if you're good:



- Managing and building my wife's personal brand

- Taking on marketing work for our clients directly (fast, high-volume marketing as a service)

- More responsibility, more income, quickly



I don't care how long you take or how you got there. I care about the result. Strong, fast, creative work is rewarded with raises, fast.



**Hours**



We work on Gulf Standard Time (Dubai, GMT+4). Team hours are 10 AM to 6 PM Dubai time, which is 2 PM to 10 PM your time in the Philippines. The whole team works the same hours. Short daily check-in, and a short written end-of-day report every day.



**Compensation**



Starting salary $600 USD/month, full-time, long-term. We start lean. Performance is rewarded fast: above-average work means steady raises and growing income over time.



**Who should not apply**



Don't apply if your background is generic social media management with no sense for a premium B2B audience. Don't apply if you chase cheap virality. And don't apply if you need someone to hand you every idea. I want a creative who thinks.



**How to apply**



Don't send me a long message or a full portfolio yet. Just text me "I'm in". That's it. I reply to everyone, and I'll tell you the next steps in the DMs.



Applications close after 60 applicants, which is usually within two days.

title: Cold Caller / SDR (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Job Description



Are you the person your friends call "the closer"? Do you actually enjoy the phone — not tolerate it, enjoy it? BlackDoor Consulting Group is hiring cold callers who back themselves and want to get paid like it.





What You'll Do



You'll cold call business owners and set them up with a free strategy call where we help them get credit-ready and access funding. That's it. No closing, no pricing conversations, no fulfillment — just great conversations that turn into booked calls.



50 dials per day, minimum — no exceptions

10–15 live conversations per day

2–3 appointments booked per day

Every single call logged in GoHighLevel (GHL) — 100% of the time

Structured day: two power-dial blocks (morning and afternoon), a midday cleanup, and an EOD report posted to the team



We'll give you the script, the objection handling playbook, and a CRM workflow that removes the guesswork. You bring the energy and the discipline.



Bottom line on pay: total earnings are a mix of your negotiated base rate plus commission and bonuses tied to performance — the harder you work the number, the more it shows up in your paycheck.





What You Need to Bring



Real outbound cold-calling experience — this is not your first rodeo

Comfort with a performance-based pay structure (base + commission)

The discipline to hit a daily number, every day, without someone standing over you

Strong phone presence — warm, confident, and able to think on your feet through objections

Basic CRM comfort (we use GoHighLevel)





What This Role Is Not



You will not close deals, quote prices, or handle client fulfillment — that's the Account Executive's job

This is not a guaranteed-base role — the tiers are earned, not given

This is not a fit if you need certainty before you've proven performance





Wage/Salary



Base rate to be discussed based on experience. Commission is added on top of any negotiated base rate, paid per converted booking, so total pay scales with performance.



Estimated on-target earnings (OTE): $500–$1,500+/month, depending on tier and performance:



$50 commission per booked appointment that converts to a paying client

+$25/week activity bonus for hitting 50 dials/day, 5 days straight

+$100/month bonus for 5+ closed bookings in a month

Paid bi-weekly, on the 1st and 15th





How to Apply



Step 1 is a 60-second voice memo. Introduce yourself and tell us why you're great at this role. This is the whole filter — no memo, no interview. We're listening for tone, energy, confidence, and whether you can follow one simple instruction.



If your memo lands, you'll move to a short video screening call, then a live cold-call simulation before any offer goes out. We move fast — most hires happen within a week of posting.

About Winnipeg Digest

Winnipeg Digest is a fast-growing local news and lifestyle brand that keeps Winnipeggers in the loop on what's happening in their city — news, food, events, community stories, and local guides. 

We reach a large, engaged local audience and we're building out our social media presence to match. You'd be joining a small, ambitious team where your work is seen by thousands of people every single day.



The Role

We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Social Media & Admin Assistant to own our day-to-day social content and support the business with light
 and admin work. This is a content-heavy role with a real creative side — you'll be making carousels and posts that go out to a real local audience — combined with the steady behind-the-scenes support that keeps things running.

You don't need to be a viral-marketing guru. You need to be dependable, quick with design tools, organized, and genuinely good at turning local information into clean, scroll-stopping posts.



What You'll Do Day-to-Day

• Publish 2 social media posts per day across Instagram and
 — a mix of local "guide" style content (best brunch spots, weekend events, things to do, neighbourhood guides) and news carousels summarizing what's happening in Winnipeg.

• Design carousels and graphics in Canva (or similar) that are clean, on-brand, and easy to read.

• Write short, engaging captions with the right hooks, hashtags, and calls to action.

• Schedule and manage the content calendar so posts go out consistently and on time.

• Engage with the audience — respond to comments and DMs, and flag anything important.

• Handle
 and admin support — organizing the inbox, replying to routine messages, light data entry, and general assistant tasks to keep the operation running smoothly.



Must-Have Skills

Proven experience creating social media carousels and graphics (Canva or equivalent) — please include a portfolio or examples.

Strong written English — clear, natural, and typo-free captions and
s.

Experience managing Instagram and
 for a business or brand.

Highly organized and reliable — you hit deadlines and don't need to be chased.

Comfortable working full Winnipeg business hours (Central Time) for real-time collaboration.

Good eye for design and detail — you notice when spacing, alignment, or wording is off.

Stable internet and a computer capable of running Canva and design tools smoothly.



Big Bonus (Not Required)

Video editing — if you can cut Reels, TikToks, and short-form video (CapCut, Premiere, etc.), that's a major plus and will make your application stand out.

Familiarity with scheduling tools (Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, etc.).

Basic knowledge of social media analytics and what makes content perform.

Interest in local news, food, and community content.



Who You Are

You're proactive — you spot what needs doing and get ahead of it.

You take feedback well and improve fast.

You're consistent. Two posts a day, every day, done well.

You communicate clearly and keep things organized.

What We Offer

Full-time, long-term, stable position with a growing brand.

Consistent Monday–Friday schedule.

A role where your creative work is visible and genuinely matters.

Room to grow as the brand grows.



How to Apply

Please apply here: 



In your application, include:

A short intro about yourself and your experience.

Links or a portfolio of carousels/graphics you've made (this is required — applications without samples won't be considered).

Whether you can edit video, and samples if so.

Confirmation that you can work full Winnipeg business hours (Central Time).

Put the word "CAROUSEL" at the top of your application so we know you read this posting carefully.
